added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arm logs, since manifest.md leaves baseline_suite and after_suite empty: base arm logs/wider-arm-base.log is 7 failed, 398 passed, EXIT=1 and head arm logs/wider-arm-head.log is 2 failed, 403 passed, EXIT=1; the two head ids (tests/test_follower_freshness.py::test_running_follower_reloads_without_stream_or_registration_gap, tests/test_one_check_trusts_a_moved_checkout.py::test_a_clean_moved_checkout_answers_on_the_current_code) both appear in the base arm's seven, so head-minus-base is empty and zero ids are added. The base arm's seven include the node's own new test reddening as its negative control, which is the expected add and is green at head (logs/head-focus.log, 2 passed, EXIT=0).

findings.text: follow-on: _replayed_baseline_repeats_the_pane re-implements the state-equality suppression the repository already owns at reckon/crew/ticker.py:1643 (RowPolicy.feed suppresses a row whose destination word equals the pane's memory), and which is repeated in this same module at reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1276 (_follow_gap_rows drops a replayed row whose state equals the remembered one); the addition neither extends nor wraps either owner, and by dropping the row before the row path it also bypasses same_word_row_is_news (ticker.py:2042), so a replayed baseline that repeats a waiting word but carries a changed duty condition is lost where the live path deliberately keeps it. It works as §71 designs, and ticker.py was outside this node's fence, so it does not hold the node.

follow-on: the local shown mirror is advanced for printed non-baseline rows only, while path.feed advances path.reported for every released row, so a replayed baseline that does print leaves shown stale for its run; a second replayed baseline naming that same state later in one _fleet_replay call is then not suppressed and prints, which is the self-transition §71 removes. Narrow (the fleet baseline list holds one row per run) and out of the tested path, so it does not hold the node.

follow-on: three consecutive blank lines separate _fleet_replay from the new helper (and again before _FOLLOW_REATTACH_FRAME), where the file otherwise uses two; ruff does not redden it because E303 is not in this repository's lint selection, so the change is ruff-clean while still off the file's own idiom.
